what: Darling Ingredients collects what the meat industry does not sell: bones, fat and offal, and turns them into proteins, fats, gelatin and, through its Diamond Green Diesel joint venture, renewable diesel.
customers: Food, feed and pet food makers buying rendered ingredients, pharmaceutical firms buying collagen, and fuel buyers of renewable diesel.
money: rendered proteins and fats for animal feed and pet food
renewable diesel through Diamond Green Diesel
moat: Collection routes from thousands of slaughterhouses and restaurants, which nobody else has built, giving it first claim on a raw material competitors cannot source.
risks: Renewable diesel margins collapsed when American tax credit rules changed
Revenue fell from $6.8B to $5.7B before partly recovering
opportunities: 9.9 times earnings and 7.4 times free cash flow with $1.1B of free cash flow
Analysts see about 57% upside, with 12 covering the stock
Collagen and gelatin demand grows with pharmaceutical and nutrition markets regardless of fuel policy
watch: Renewable diesel margins and the collagen business's growth.
